rows.question: Tefik Selim Mborja was a part of a party that held power in Albania until what year?
rows.reply:
Tefik Selim Mborja was a key figure in the Albanian Fascist Party during World War II. This party held nominal power in Albania from 1939, when Italy conquered the country, until 1943, when Italy capitulated to the Allies. Following the surrender, Albania came under German occupation, and Mborja was arrested and executed in 1944.

Answer: 1943
